ko.title: 금의 기록적인 질주: 중앙은행들은 왜 계속 매수하며, 이것이 무엇을 의미하는가

segments.src: Gold has spent much of the past couple of years trading near record highs.
segments.tr: 금은 지난 몇 년간 대부분의 기간 동안 기록적인 고점 근처에서 거래되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Behind the rally is a steady, large-scale shift in who is buying: central banks.
segments.tr: 이러한 상승세의 배경에는 누가 금을 매수하는지에 대한 꾸준하고 대규모적인 변화, 즉 중앙은행들이 있습니다.

segments.src: Their purchases have become one of the most closely watched forces in the market.
segments.tr: 이들의 매수는 시장에서 가장 면밀히 주시하는 동력 중 하나가 되었습니다.

segments.src: This article explains what is driving that demand, what it may say about the global financial system, and what it means for everyday savers.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 무엇이 이러한 수요를 이끄는지, 이것이 글로벌 금융 시스템에 대해 무엇을 시사하는지, 그리고 일반 저축자들에게는 어떤 의미가 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## Who is buying, and why it matters
segments.tr: ## 누가 매수하고 있으며, 왜 중요한가

segments.src: Central banks hold gold as part of their foreign reserves, alongside government bonds and foreign currencies.
segments.tr: 중앙은행은 국채 및 외화와 함께 외환보유고의 일부로 금을 보유합니다.

segments.src: For decades, many of them were net sellers or stayed on the sidelines.
segments.tr: 수십 년 동안 많은 중앙은행은 순매도자였거나 시장을 관망했습니다.

segments.src: That changed after the 2008 financial crisis, and the pace of buying has picked up further in recent years.
segments.tr: 2008년 금융 위기 이후 상황이 바뀌었고, 최근 몇 년간 매수 속도는 더욱 빨라졌습니다.

segments.src: According to the World Gold Council, which compiles data from official sources and the International Monetary Fund, annual central bank purchases have recently run well above the long-term average.
segments.tr: 공식 출처와 국제통화기금(IMF)의 데이터를 집계하는 세계금협회(World Gold Council)에 따르면, 최근 중앙은행의 연간 금 매수량은 장기 평균을 훨씬 상회하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This matters because central banks are unusual buyers.
segments.tr: 중앙은행은 일반적인 매수자와 다르기 때문에 이 현상은 중요합니다.

segments.src: They tend to be price-insensitive and long-term.
segments.tr: 그들은 가격에 둔감하며 장기적인 관점을 갖는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: They are not trading for quick profit.
segments.tr: 그들은 단기 수익을 위해 거래하지 않습니다.

segments.src: When they buy, they usually keep the metal for years, which removes supply from the market and can provide a floor under prices.
segments.tr: 그들이 매수할 때 보통 수년간 금을 보유하는데, 이는 시장에서 공급을 제거하고 가격의 하한선을 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## 수요를 이끄는 네 가지 요인

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
segments.tr: ### 1. 인플레이션 우려

segments.src: Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: 2021년 이후 많은 경제권에서 물가가 급격히 상승했습니다.

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: 여러 국가에서 인플레이션이 진정되었지만, 그 경험은 흔적을 남겼습니다.

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: 금은 종종 특정 정부의 약속에 얽매이지 않는 가치 저장 수단으로 간주됩니다.

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자와 투자자 모두 화폐의 구매력이 약화될 수 있다는 점을 상기하게 되었습니다.

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. 달러 및 보유고 집중도에 대한 우려

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: 달러는 여전히 지배적인 기축 통화이며, 대부분의 분석가는 앞으로도 오랫동안 그럴 것으로 예상합니다.

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 많은 중앙은행은 다변화를 원합니다.

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: 주요 경제국의 막대한 정부 부채 수준과 금융 제재의 사용은 일부 국가들로 하여금 동결되거나 제한될 수 있는 자산에 보유고를 너무 많이 두는 것이 얼마나 안전한지 의문을 갖게 했습니다.

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: 금은 발행자도 거래 상대방도 없으므로 외국 은행 예금처럼 동결될 수 없습니다.

segments.src: This is not the same as abandoning the dollar.
segments.tr: 이는 달러를 포기하는 것과는 다릅니다.

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
segments.tr: 이는 점진적인 다변화로 묘사하는 것이 더 정확합니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. 지정학적 리스크

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: 전쟁, 무역 분쟁, 변화하는 동맹 관계는 불확실성을 높였습니다.

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.
segments.tr: 중앙은행 보유고 관리자들을 대상으로 한 설문조사에서는 반복적으로 금 보유의 이유로 지정학적 리스크를 꼽았습니다.

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: 불확실한 시기에 위기 상황에서도 가치를 유지하고 다른 국가의 금융 시스템에 의존하지 않는 자산은 매력적으로 보입니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. 낮은 기회비용 기대

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: 금은 이자를 지급하지 않으므로 금리가 하락할 것으로 예상되거나 채권의 실질 수익률(인플레이션 조정 후)이 낮을 때 더 좋아 보이는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: 금리 기대치의 변화는 종종 금 가격의 움직임과 일치했습니다.

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## 매수세가 시사하는 바

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: 분석가들은 단일 데이터 포인트에 너무 큰 의미를 부여하는 것을 경계하지만, 몇 가지 주제가 두드러집니다:

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **신뢰와 다변화.** 보유고 관리자들은 과거보다 더 넓게 리스크를 분산하고 있는 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **신흥 시장의 주도.** 최근 몇 년간 가장 큰 매수자 중 다수는 신흥 경제국의 중앙은행이었으며, 이들은 종종 전체 보유고 대비 상대적으로 적은 양의 금을 보유하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.
segments.tr: - **예측이 아닌 헤지.** 금을 매수한다고 해서 반드시 당국이 위기를 예상한다는 의미는 아닙니다. 보험은 재난이 확실해서가 아니라 미래가 불확실하기 때문에 드는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## 일반 저축자들에게 미치는 의미

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: 기록적인 가격에 대한 헤드라인은 사람들을 서둘러 뛰어들게 유혹할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: 명심해야 할 몇 가지 기본적인 사항은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **기록적인 고점이 보증은 아닙니다.** 금 가격은 하락할 수 있으며, 때로는 수년간 하락하기도 합니다. 2011년 정점 이후, 가격은 회복되기 전까지 긴 기간 동안 하락했습니다.

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **금은 소득을 창출하지 않습니다.** 배당금을 지급할 수 있는 주식이나 이자를 지급하는 채권과 달리, 금의 수익은 전적으로 가격 변동에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **비용이 누적됩니다.** 실물 금은 딜러 프리미엄, 보관 및 보험 비용이 발생합니다. 금 기반 펀드는 연간 수수료를 부과합니다. 매수 전에 이를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.
segments.tr: - **집중이 아닌 다변화.** 많은 금융 교육자들은 금을 보유한다면 포트폴리오의 중심이 아니라 다변화된 포트폴리오의 일부로 적당히 보유해야 한다고 제안합니다.

segments.src: - **Know what you own.** Coins, bars, exchange-traded funds and mining stocks behave differently. Mining shares carry company risk and can swing far more than the metal itself.
segments.tr: - **자신이 무엇을 소유하는지 파악하십시오.** 코인, 바, 상장지수펀드(ETF), 광산 주식은 다르게 움직입니다. 광산 주식은 기업 리스크를 수반하며 금속 자체보다 훨씬 더 크게 변동할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Beware of pressure sales.** Be skeptical of anyone claiming that gold is a sure thing or urging you to act immediately. Use well-established, regulated sellers.
segments.tr: - **강매를 주의하십시오.** 금이 확실한 투자처라고 주장하거나 즉각적인 행동을 촉구하는 사람들을 경계하십시오. 잘 확립되고 규제받는 판매자를 이용하십시오.

segments.src: Your own situation matters most: your time horizon, emergency savings, debts and tolerance for ups and downs.
segments.tr: 가장 중요한 것은 본인의 상황입니다: 투자 기간, 비상 자금, 부채, 그리고 등락에 대한 감내 수준입니다.

segments.src: A licensed financial adviser can help weigh these.
segments.tr: 면허를 가진 재무 상담사가 이러한 요소를 따져보는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Central banks are buying gold for reasons that go beyond short-term price moves: inflation memory, a wish to diversify away from heavy reliance on a single currency, and a more uncertain world.
segments.tr: 중앙은행들은 단기적인 가격 변동을 넘어선 이유로 금을 매수하고 있습니다: 인플레이션에 대한 기억, 단일 통화에 대한 과도한 의존에서 벗어나려는 다변화 욕구, 그리고 더 불확실해진 세계가 그 이유입니다.

segments.src: Their steady demand has helped keep prices elevated.
segments.tr: 그들의 꾸준한 수요는 가격을 높게 유지하는 데 일조했습니다.

segments.src: But the same factors that support gold can change quickly, and prices remain volatile.
segments.tr: 하지만 금을 지지하는 동일한 요인들이 빠르게 변할 수 있으며, 가격은 여전히 변동성이 큽니다.

segments.src: For savers, the lesson is less about chasing a record and more about understanding why large institutions treat gold as a long-term safeguard, and then deciding whether and how much of that logic fits your own plans.
segments.tr: 저축자들에게 주는 교훈은 기록적인 가격을 쫓는 것보다는 대형 기관들이 왜 금을 장기적인 안전장치로 취급하는지 이해하고, 그 논리가 자신의 계획에 얼마나 부합하는지 결정하는 것입니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 및 교육 목적으로만 제공됩니다.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: 투자, 세금 또는 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Past performance does not guarantee future results, and the value of any investment can go down as well as up.*
segments.tr: 과거의 성과가 미래의 결과를 보장하지 않으며, 모든 투자의 가치는 하락할 수도 상승할 수도 있습니다.*

zh.title: 黄金的创纪录行情：为什么央행仍在买入以及这释放了什么信号

segments.src: Gold has spent much of the past couple of years trading near record highs.
segments.tr: 黄金在过去几年的大部分时间里一直在创纪录的高位附近交易。

segments.src: Behind the rally is a steady, large-scale shift in who is buying: central banks.
segments.tr: 这轮涨势背后是买方构成的稳定、大规模转变：中央银行。

segments.src: Their purchases have become one of the most closely watched forces in the market.
segments.tr: 它们的购买行为已成为市场上受到密切关注的力量之一。

segments.src: This article explains what is driving that demand, what it may say about the global financial system, and what it means for everyday savers.
segments.tr: 本文解释了推动这种需求的原因、它对全球金融体系的意义，以及它对普通储户意味着什么。

segments.src: ## Who is buying, and why it matters
segments.tr: ## 谁在买入，以及为什么重要

segments.src: Central banks hold gold as part of their foreign reserves, alongside government bonds and foreign currencies.
segments.tr: 中央银行将黄金作为外汇储备的一部分持有，与政府债券和外汇并列。

segments.src: For decades, many of them were net sellers or stayed on the sidelines.
segments.tr: 几十年来，它们中的许多人一直是净卖家或作壁上观。

segments.src: That changed after the 2008 financial crisis, and the pace of buying has picked up further in recent years.
segments.tr: 2008年金融危机后情况发生了变化，近年来买入步伐进一步加快。

segments.src: According to the World Gold Council, which compiles data from official sources and the International Monetary Fund, annual central bank purchases have recently run well above the long-term average.
segments.tr: 根据汇总官方渠道和国际货币基金组织数据的世界黄金协会的数据，近年来央行的年度购买量一直远高于长期平均水平。

segments.src: This matters because central banks are unusual buyers.
segments.tr: 这很重要，因为央行是不寻常的买家。

segments.src: They tend to be price-insensitive and long-term.
segments.tr: 它们往往对价格不敏感且具有长期视角。

segments.src: They are not trading for quick profit.
segments.tr: 它们不是为了快速获利而进行交易。

segments.src: When they buy, they usually keep the metal for years, which removes supply from the market and can provide a floor under prices.
segments.tr: 当它们购买时，通常会保留黄金多年，这从市场上移除了供应，并能为价格提供支撑。

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## 推动需求的四大力量

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
segments.tr: ### 1. 通胀担忧

segments.src: Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: 2021年后，许多经济体的价格急剧上涨。

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: 尽管多个国家的通胀已经降温，但这段经历留下了印记。

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: 黄金通常被视为一种不与任何单一政府承诺挂钩的价值储藏手段。

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: 决策者和投资者都再次认识到，货币的购买力可能会受到侵蚀。

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. 对美元和储备集中的担忧

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: 美元仍然是主导储备货币，大多数分析师预计这种情况在很长一段时间内不会改变。

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: 即便如此，许多央行仍希望实现多元化。

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: 主要经济体的大规模政府债务水平以及金融制裁的使用促使一些国家质疑，将过多储备持有时可能被冻结或限制的资产是否安全。

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: 黄金没有发行人和交易对手，因此不会像外国银行存款那样被冻结。

segments.src: This is not the same as abandoning the dollar.
segments.tr: 这并不等于放弃美元。

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
segments.tr: 将其描述为边际上的渐进多元化更为准确。

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. 地缘政治风险

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: 战争、贸易争端和联盟变动增加了不确定性。

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.
segments.tr: 对央行储备管理者的调查一再指出，地缘政治风险是持有黄金的原因。

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: 在不确定的时期，一种能够在危机中保持价值且不依赖于其他国家金融系统的资产显得很有吸引力。

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. 较低的机会成本预期

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: 黄金不支付利息，因此当利率预期下降或债券的实际（扣除通胀后）回报率较低时，它往往看起来更好。

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: 利率预期的转变往往与金价的走势相吻合。

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## 购买行为可能释放的信号

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: 分析师提醒不要过度解读任何单一数据点，但有几个主题引人注目：

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **信任与多元化。** 储备管理者似乎比过去更广泛地分散风险。

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **新兴市场的主导地位。** 近年来最大的买家中有许多是新兴经济体的央行，与它们的总储备相比，这些央行通常持有相对较少的黄金。

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.
segments.tr: - **对冲，而非预测。** 购买黄金并不一定意味着官员们预计会发生危机。购买保险是因为未来充满不确定性，而不是因为灾难必然发生。

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## 对普通储户意味着什么

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: 关于创纪录价格的头条新闻会诱使人们仓促入场。

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: 需要牢记的一些基本要点：

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **创纪录的高点并不保证未来。** 金价可以而且确实会下跌，有时甚至会持续多年。在2011年的峰值之后，价格在复苏前经历了很长一段下跌期。

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **黄金不产生收益。** 与可能支付股息的股票或支付利息的债券不同，黄金的回报完全取决于其价格变化。

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **成本不断累积。** 实物黄金涉及经销商溢价、存储和保险。黄金支持的基金收取年度费用。在购买前请检查这些费用。

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.
segments.tr: - **多元化，而非集中化。** 许多金融教育者建议，如果持有黄金，它应该是一个多元化投资组合中适度的部分，而不是核心。

segments.src: - **Know what you own.** Coins, bars, exchange-traded funds and mining stocks behave differently. Mining shares carry company risk and can swing far more than the metal itself.
segments.tr: - **了解你所拥有的资产。** 硬币、金条、交易所交易基金和矿业股的表现各不相同。矿业股承载公司风险，其波动幅度可能远大于金属本身。

segments.src: - **Beware of pressure sales.** Be skeptical of anyone claiming that gold is a sure thing or urging you to act immediately. Use well-established, regulated sellers.
segments.tr: - **谨防推销。** 对任何声称黄金稳赚不赔或敦促你立即行动的人保持怀疑。使用成熟、受监管的卖家。

segments.src: Your own situation matters most: your time horizon, emergency savings, debts and tolerance for ups and downs.
segments.tr: 你自己的情况最重要：你的时间跨度、应急储蓄、债务以及对涨跌的承受能力。

segments.src: A licensed financial adviser can help weigh these.
segments.tr: 持牌理财顾问可以帮助权衡这些因素。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Central banks are buying gold for reasons that go beyond short-term price moves: inflation memory, a wish to diversify away from heavy reliance on a single currency, and a more uncertain world.
segments.tr: 中央银行购买黄金的原因超越了短期价格变动：对通胀的记忆、摆脱对单一货币过度依赖的愿望，以及一个更加不确定的世界。

segments.src: Their steady demand has helped keep prices elevated.
segments.tr: 它们持续的需求有助于维持高位价格。

segments.src: But the same factors that support gold can change quickly, and prices remain volatile.
segments.tr: 但支持黄金的相同因素可能会迅速变化，价格依然波动。

segments.src: For savers, the lesson is less about chasing a record and more about understanding why large institutions treat gold as a long-term safeguard, and then deciding whether and how much of that logic fits your own plans.
segments.tr: 对于储户而言，教训与其说是追逐纪录，不如说是理解为什么大型机构将黄金视为长期保障，然后决定这种逻辑是否以及在多大程度上符合你自己的计划。

segments.tr: 它不构成投资、税务或财务建议。

hi.title: सोने की रिकॉर्ड दौड़: केंद्रीय बैंक क्यों खरीदारी जारी रख रहे हैं और यह क्या संकेत देता है

segments.src: Gold has spent much of the past couple of years trading near record highs.
segments.tr: सोना पिछले दो वर्षों के अधिकांश समय में रिकॉर्ड ऊंचाई के करीब कारोबार करता रहा है।

segments.src: Behind the rally is a steady, large-scale shift in who is buying: central banks.
segments.tr: इस तेजी के पीछे खरीदारों के वर्ग में एक स्थिर, बड़े पैमाने पर बदलाव है: केंद्रीय बैंक।

segments.src: Their purchases have become one of the most closely watched forces in the market.
segments.tr: उनकी खरीदारी बाजार में सबसे करीब से देखी जाने वाली ताकतों में से एक बन गई है।

segments.src: This article explains what is driving that demand, what it may say about the global financial system, and what it means for everyday savers.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि उस मांग को क्या प्रेरित कर रहा है, यह वैश्विक वित्तीय प्रणाली के बारे में क्या कह सकता है, और आम बचतकर्ताओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है।

segments.src: ## Who is buying, and why it matters
segments.tr: ## कौन खरीद रहा है, और यह क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Central banks hold gold as part of their foreign reserves, alongside government bonds and foreign currencies.
segments.tr: केंद्रीय बैंक सरकारी बॉन्ड और विदेशी मुद्राओं के साथ-साथ अपने विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार के हिस्से के रूप में सोना रखते हैं।

segments.src: For decades, many of them were net sellers or stayed on the sidelines.
segments.tr: दशकों तक, उनमें से कई शुद्ध विक्रेता थे या किनारे पर बने रहे।

segments.src: That changed after the 2008 financial crisis, and the pace of buying has picked up further in recent years.
segments.tr: 2008 के वित्तीय संकट के बाद स्थिति बदल गई, और हाल के वर्षों में खरीदारी की गति और तेज़ हो गई है।

segments.src: According to the World Gold Council, which compiles data from official sources and the International Monetary Fund, annual central bank purchases have recently run well above the long-term average.
segments.tr: वर्ल्ड गोल्ड काउंसिल के अनुसार, जो आधिकारिक स्रोतों और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष से डेटा संकलित करता है, हाल ही में वार्षिक केंद्रीय बैंक की खरीदारी दीर्घकालिक औसत से काफी ऊपर रही है।

segments.src: This matters because central banks are unusual buyers.
segments.tr: यह मायने रखता है क्योंकि केंद्रीय बैंक असामान्य खरीदार हैं।

segments.src: They tend to be price-insensitive and long-term.
segments.tr: वे कीमत के प्रति असंवेदनशील और दीर्घकालिक होते हैं।

segments.src: They are not trading for quick profit.
segments.tr: वे त्वरित लाभ के लिए व्यापार नहीं कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: When they buy, they usually keep the metal for years, which removes supply from the market and can provide a floor under prices.
segments.tr: जब वे खरीदते हैं, तो वे आमतौर पर धातु को वर्षों तक रखते हैं, जो बाजार से आपूर्ति को हटा देता है और कीमतों को एक समर्थन प्रदान कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## मांग के पीछे चार ताकतें

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: 2021 के बाद कई अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में कीमतें तेजी से बढ़ीं।

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: यद्यपि कई देशों में मुद्रास्फीति ठंडी हुई है, फिर भी इस अनुभव ने एक छाप छोड़ी है।

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: सोने को अक्सर मूल्य के एक ऐसे भंडार के रूप में देखा जाता है जो किसी एक सरकार के वादों से बंधा नहीं है।

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माताओं और निवेशकों दोनों को याद दिलाया गया है कि पैसे की क्रय शक्ति क्षीण हो सकती है।

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. डॉलर और रिजर्व एकाग्रता के बारे में चिंताएं

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: डॉलर प्रमुख आरक्षित मुद्रा बना हुआ है, और अधिकांश विश्लेषकों को उम्मीद है कि यह लंबे समय तक ऐसा ही रहेगा।

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: फिर भी, कई केंद्रीय बैंक विविधीकरण (विविधता) चाहते हैं।

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में बड़े पैमाने पर सरकारी ऋण स्तरों और वित्तीय प्रतिबंधों के उपयोग ने कुछ देशों को यह पूछने के लिए प्रेरित किया है कि ऐसी संपत्तियों में अपने भंडार का बहुत अधिक हिस्सा रखना कितना सुरक्षित है जिन्हें फ्रीज या प्रतिबंधित किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: सोने का कोई जारीकर्ता और कोई काउंटरपार्टी नहीं होता है, इसलिए इसे विदेशी बैंक जमा की तरह फ्रीज नहीं किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: This is not the same as abandoning the dollar.
segments.tr: यह डॉलर छोड़ने जैसा नहीं है।

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
segments.tr: इसे सीमाओं पर क्रमिक विविधीकरण के रूप में बेहतर वर्णित किया गया है।

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. भू-राजनीतिक जोखिम

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: युद्धों, व्यापार विवादों और बदलते गठबंधनों ने अनिश्चितता बढ़ा दी है।

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.
segments.tr: केंद्रीय बैंक रिजर्व प्रबंधकों के सर्वेक्षणों ने बार-बार सोना रखने के कारण के रूप में भू-राजनीतिक जोखिम की ओर इशारा किया है।

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: अनिश्चित समय में, एक ऐसी संपत्ति जो संकटों के दौरान मूल्य बनाए रखती है और दूसरे देश की वित्तीय प्रणाली पर निर्भर नहीं करती है, आकर्षक लगती है।

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. अवसर लागत की कम अपेक्षाएं

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: सोना कोई ब्याज नहीं देता है, इसलिए यह तब बेहतर दिखता है जब ब्याज दरें गिरने की उम्मीद होती है या जब बॉन्ड पर वास्तविक (मुद्रास्फीति के बाद) रिटर्न कम होता है।

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: दर अपेक्षाओं में बदलाव अक्सर सोने की कीमत में बदलाव के साथ मेल खाते हैं।

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## खरीदारी क्या संकेत दे सकती है

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: विश्लेषक किसी एक डेटा बिंदु से बहुत अधिक अर्थ निकालने के खिलाफ चेतावनी देते हैं, लेकिन कुछ विषय प्रमुखता से उभरते हैं:

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **विश्वास और विविधीकरण।** रिजर्व प्रबंधक अतीत की तुलना में जोखिम को अधिक व्यापक रूप से फैलाते दिख रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **उभरते बाजार का नेतृत्व।** हाल के वर्षों में कई सबसे बड़े खरीदार उभरती अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में केंद्रीय बैंक रहे हैं, जो अक्सर अपने कुल भंडार की तुलना में अपेक्षाकृत कम सोना रखते हैं।

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.
segments.tr: - **एक बचाव (हेज), पूर्वानुमान नहीं।** सोना खरीदने का मतलब यह नहीं है कि अधिकारियों को संकट की उम्मीद है। बीमा इसलिए खरीदा जाता है क्योंकि भविष्य अनिश्चित है, इसलिए नहीं कि आपदा निश्चित है।

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## आम बचतकर्ताओं के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: रिकॉर्ड कीमतों की सुर्खियां लोगों को जल्दबाजी में खरीदारी करने के लिए लुभा सकती हैं।

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: ध्यान में रखने योग्य कुछ व्यावहारिक बातें:

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **रिकॉर्ड ऊंचाई गारंटी नहीं है।** सोने की कीमतें गिर सकती हैं और गिरती भी हैं, कभी-कभी सालों तक। 2011 में शिखर के बाद, उबरने से पहले कीमतों में लंबी अवधि तक गिरावट आई थी।

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **सोना कोई आय उत्पन्न नहीं करता है।** लाभांश देने वाले शेयरों या ब्याज देने वाले बॉन्ड के विपरीत, सोने का रिटर्न पूरी तरह से उसकी कीमत में बदलाव पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **लागत जुड़ती जाती है।** भौतिक सोने में डीलर प्रीमियम, भंडारण और बीमा शामिल होता है। गोल्ड-समर्थित फंड वार्षिक शुल्क लेते हैं। खरीदने से पहले इनकी जांच कर लें।

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.

es.title: El récord del oro: por qué los bancos centrales siguen comprando y qué significa

segments.src: Gold has spent much of the past couple of years trading near record highs.
segments.tr: El oro ha pasado gran parte de los últimos años cotizando cerca de máximos históricos.

segments.src: Behind the rally is a steady, large-scale shift in who is buying: central banks.
segments.tr: Detrás del repunte hay un cambio constante y a gran escala en quién está comprando: los bancos centrales.

segments.src: Their purchases have become one of the most closely watched forces in the market.
segments.tr: Sus compras se han convertido en una de las fuerzas más observadas en el mercado.

segments.src: This article explains what is driving that demand, what it may say about the global financial system, and what it means for everyday savers.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica qué impulsa esa demanda, qué puede decir sobre el sistema financiero global y qué significa para los ahorradores comunes.

segments.src: ## Who is buying, and why it matters
segments.tr: ## Quién compra y por qué es importante

segments.src: Central banks hold gold as part of their foreign reserves, alongside government bonds and foreign currencies.
segments.tr: Los bancos centrales mantienen oro como parte de sus reservas extranjeras, junto con bonos gubernamentales y divisas extranjeras.

segments.src: For decades, many of them were net sellers or stayed on the sidelines.
segments.tr: Durante décadas, muchos de ellos fueron vendedores netos o se mantuvieron al margen.

segments.src: That changed after the 2008 financial crisis, and the pace of buying has picked up further in recent years.
segments.tr: Eso cambió después de la crisis financiera de 2008, y el ritmo de compra se ha acelerado aún más en los últimos años.

segments.src: According to the World Gold Council, which compiles data from official sources and the International Monetary Fund, annual central bank purchases have recently run well above the long-term average.
segments.tr: Según el Consejo Mundial del Oro, que recopila datos de fuentes oficiales y del Fondo Monetario Internacional, las compras anuales de los bancos centrales han estado recientemente muy por encima del promedio a largo plazo.

segments.src: This matters because central banks are unusual buyers.
segments.tr: Esto es importante porque los bancos centrales son compradores inusuales.

segments.src: They tend to be price-insensitive and long-term.
segments.tr: Tienden a ser insensibles al precio y a largo plazo.

segments.src: They are not trading for quick profit.
segments.tr: No operan para obtener ganancias rápidas.

segments.src: When they buy, they usually keep the metal for years, which removes supply from the market and can provide a floor under prices.
segments.tr: Cuando compran, generalmente conservan el metal durante años, lo que elimina la oferta del mercado y puede proporcionar un suelo para los precios.

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## Cuatro fuerzas detrás de la demanda

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
segments.tr: ### 1. Preocupaciones por la inflación

segments.src: Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: Los precios subieron drásticamente en muchas economías después de 2021.

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: Aunque la inflación se ha enfriado en varios países, la experiencia dejó huella.

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: El oro a menudo se considera una reserva de valor que no está ligada a las promesas de ningún gobierno.

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: Tanto a los responsables políticos como a los inversores se les ha recordado que el poder adquisitivo del dinero puede erosionarse.

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. Preocupaciones sobre el dólar y la concentración de reservas

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: El dólar de EE.

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: UU. sigue siendo la moneda de reserva dominante, y la mayoría de los analistas esperan que siga siendo así durante mucho tiempo.

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: Aun así, muchos bancos centrales quieren diversificar.

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: Los altos niveles de deuda pública en las principales economías y el uso de sanciones financieras han llevado a algunos países a preguntarse qué tan seguro es mantener demasiadas reservas en activos que pueden ser congelados o restringidos.

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: El oro no tiene emisor ni contraparte, por lo que no puede congelarse de la misma manera que un depósito bancario extranjero.

segments.src: This is not the same as abandoning the dollar.
segments.tr: Esto no es lo mismo que abandonar el dólar.

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
segments.tr: Se describe mejor como una diversificación gradual al margen.

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. Riesgo geopolítico

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: Las guerras, las disputas comerciales y las alianzas cambiantes han aumentado la incertidumbre.

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.
segments.tr: Las encuestas a los gestores de reservas de los bancos centrales han señalado repetidamente el riesgo geopolítico como una razón para mantener oro.

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: En tiempos de incertidumbre, un activo que mantiene su valor a través de las crisis y no depende del sistema financiero de otro país parece atractivo.

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. Expectativas de menor costo de oportunidad

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: El oro no paga intereses, por lo que tiende a verse mejor cuando se espera que las tasas de interés caigan o cuando los rendimientos reales (después de la inflación) de los bonos son bajos.

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: Los cambios en las expectativas de tasas a menudo han coincidido con movimientos en el precio del oro.

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## Qué puede señalar la compra

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: Los analistas advierten contra la interpretación excesiva de cualquier punto de datos único, pero destacan algunos temas:

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **Confianza y diversificación.** Los gestores de reservas parecen estar distribuyendo el riesgo de manera más amplia que en el pasado.

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **Liderazgo de los mercados emergentes.** Muchos de los mayores compradores en los últimos años han sido bancos centrales de economías emergentes, que a menudo poseen relativamente poco oro en comparación con sus reservas totales.

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.
segments.tr: - **Una cobertura, no un pronóstico.** Comprar oro no significa necesariamente que los funcionarios esperen una crisis. El seguro se compra porque el futuro es incierto, no porque un desastre sea seguro.

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## Qué significa para los ahorradores comunes

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: Los titulares sobre precios récord pueden tentar a la gente a apresurarse.

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: Algunos puntos fundamentales a tener en cuenta:

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **Los máximos históricos no son garantías.** Los precios del oro pueden caer y de hecho caen, a veces durante años. Después del pico en 2011, los precios disminuyeron durante un largo período antes de recuperarse.

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **El oro no produce ingresos.** A diferencia de las acciones que pueden pagar dividendos o los bonos que pagan intereses, el rendimiento del oro depende totalmente de su cambio de precio.

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **Los costos se acumulan.** El oro físico implica primas de distribuidor, almacenamiento y seguro. Los fondos respaldados por oro cobran tarifas anuales. Verifique esto antes de comprar.

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.
segments.tr: - **Diversificación, no concentración.** Muchos educadores financieros sugieren que el oro, si se mantiene, debería ser una parte modesta de una cartera diversificada en lugar de la pieza central.

segments.src: - **Know what you own.** Coins, bars, exchange-traded funds and mining stocks behave differently. Mining shares carry company risk and can swing far more than the metal itself.
segments.tr: - **Sepa lo que posee.** Las monedas, lingotes, fondos cotizados en bolsa y acciones mineras se comportan de manera diferente. Las acciones mineras conllevan riesgo de empresa y pueden oscilar mucho más que el metal en sí.

segments.src: - **Beware of pressure sales.** Be skeptical of anyone claiming that gold is a sure thing or urging you to act immediately. Use well-established, regulated sellers.
segments.tr: - **Cuidado con las ventas a presión.** Sea escéptico con cualquiera que afirme que el oro es algo seguro o que le inste a actuar de inmediato. Utilice vendedores bien establecidos y regulados.

segments.src: Your own situation matters most: your time horizon, emergency savings, debts and tolerance for ups and downs.
segments.tr: Su propia situación es lo que más importa: su horizonte temporal, ahorros de emergencia, deudas y tolerancia a los altibajos.

segments.src: A licensed financial adviser can help weigh these.
segments.tr: Un asesor financiero con licencia puede ayudar a evaluar esto.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: Central banks are buying gold for reasons that go beyond short-term price moves: inflation memory, a wish to diversify away from heavy reliance on a single currency, and a more uncertain world.
segments.tr: Los bancos centrales están comprando oro por razones que van más allá de los movimientos de precios a corto plazo: memoria de la inflación, el deseo de diversificarse lejos de una fuerte dependencia de una sola moneda y un mundo más incierto.

segments.src: Their steady demand has helped keep prices elevated.
segments.tr: Su demanda constante ha ayudado a mantener los precios elevados.

segments.src: But the same factors that support gold can change quickly, and prices remain volatile.
segments.tr: Pero los mismos factores que respaldan al oro pueden cambiar rápidamente, y los precios siguen siendo volátiles.

segments.src: For savers, the lesson is less about chasing a record and more about understanding why large institutions treat gold as a long-term safeguard, and then deciding whether and how much of that logic fits your own plans.
segments.tr: Para los ahorradores, la lección es menos sobre perseguir un récord y más sobre entender por qué las grandes instituciones tratan al oro como una salvaguarda a largo plazo, y luego decidir si esa lógica se ajusta a sus propios planes y en qué medida.

segments.tr: *Este artículo es solo para información general y educación.

segments.tr: No es asesoramiento de inversión, fiscal o financiero.

segments.tr: El rendimiento pasado no garantiza resultados futuros, y el valor de cualquier inversión puede bajar tanto como subir.*

segments.tr: من الأفضل وصفه بأنه تنويع تدريجي على الهوامش.

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. المخاطر الجيوسياسية

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: أدت الحروب والنزاعات التجارية وتحول التحالفات إلى زيادة حالة عدم اليقين.

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: في أوقات عدم اليقين، يبدو الأصل الذي يحافظ على قيمته عبر الأزمات ولا اعتمد على النظام المالي لدولة أخرى جاذبًا.

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. توقعات انخفاض تكلفة الفرصة البديلة

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: لا يدفع الذهب أي فائدة، لذلك يميل إلى أن يبدو أفضل عندما يُتوقع انخفاض أسعار الفائدة أو عندما تكون العوائد الحقيقية (بعد تعديل التضخم) على السندات منخفضة.

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تزامنت التحولات في توقعات أسعار الفائدة مع تحركات أسعار الذهب.

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## ما الذي قد تشير إليه عمليات الشراء

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: يحذر المحللون من الإفراط في تفسير أي نقطة بيانات منفردة، ولكن هناك عدة موضوعات بارزة:

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **الثقة والتنويع.** يبدو أن مديري الاحتياطيات يوزعون المخاطر بشكل أوسع مما كان عليه الحال في الماضي.

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **ريادة الأسواق الناشئة.** كان العديد من أكبر المشترين في السنوات الأخيرة من البنوك المركزية في الاقتصاديات الناشئة، والتي غالباً ما تحتفظ بنسبة ضئيلة نسبياً من الذهب مقارنة بإجمالي احتياطياتها.

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للمدخرين العاديين

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: يمكن للعناوين الرئيسية حول الأسعار القياسية أن تغري الناس بالاندفاع للشراء.

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: إليك بعض النقاط الواقعية التي يجب وضعها في الاعتبار:

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **المستويات القياسية ليست ضمانات.** أسعار الذهب يمكن أن تنخفض وتخفض بالفعل، وأحياناً لسنوات. بعد الذروة في عام 2011، انخفضت الأسعار لفترة طويلة قبل أن تتعافى.

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **الذهب لا يولد أي دخل.** على عكس الأسهم التي قد تدفع أرباحاً أو السندات التي تدفع فوائد، يعتمد عائد الذهب بالكامل على تغير سعره.

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **التكاليف تتراكم.** يتضمن الذهب الفعلي عمولات التجار والتخزين والتأمين. وتفرض الصناديق المدعومة بالذهب رسوماً سنوية. تحقق من هذه التكاليف قبل الشراء.

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.
segments.tr: - **التنويع، وليس التركيز.** يقترح العديد من الخبراء الماليين أن الذهب، إذا أُدرج مطلقاً، يجب أن يكون جزءاً متواضعاً من محفظة متنوعة بدلاً من أن يكون حجر الزاوية.

segments.src: - **Know what you own.** Coins, bars, exchange-traded funds and mining stocks behave differently. Mining shares carry company risk and can swing far more than the metal itself.
segments.tr: - **اعرف ما تملكه.** تتصرف العملات المعدنية والسبائك والصناديق المتداولة في البورصة وأسهم التعدين بشكل مختلف. تحمل أسهم التعدين مخاطر الشركة ويمكن أن تتأرجح بنسبة أكبر بكثير من المعدن نفسه.

segments.src: - **Beware of pressure sales.** Be skeptical of anyone claiming that gold is a sure thing or urging you to act immediately. Use well-established, regulated sellers.
segments.tr: - **احذر من المبيعات الضخمة والموجهة بالضغط.** كن متشككاً تجاه أي شخص يدعي أن الذهب مضمون أو يحثك على اتخاذ إجراء فوري. استخدم بائعين موثوقين ومخضعين للرقابة.

segments.src: Your own situation matters most: your time horizon, emergency savings, debts and tolerance for ups and downs.
segments.tr: وضعك الخاص هو الأكثر أهمية: أفقك الزمني، ومدخرات الطوارئ، والديون، ومدى تحملك للتقلبات.

segments.src: A licensed financial adviser can help weigh these.
segments.tr: يمكن لمستشار مالي مرخص أن يساعد في تقييم هذه العوامل.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Central banks are buying gold for reasons that go beyond short-term price moves: inflation memory, a wish to diversify away from heavy reliance on a single currency, and a more uncertain world.
segments.tr: تشتري البنوك المركزية الذهب لأسباب تتجاوز تحركات الأسعار قصيرة الأجل: ذاكرة التضخم، والرغبة في التنويع بعيداً عن الاعتماد المفرط على عملة واحدة، وعالم أكثر تعقيداً وعدم يقين.

segments.src: Their steady demand has helped keep prices elevated.

segments.src: But the same factors that support gold can change quickly, and prices remain volatile.
segments.tr: لكن نفس العوامل التي تدعم الذهب يمكن أن تتغير بسرعة، وتظل الأسعار متقلبة.

segments.src: For savers, the lesson is less about chasing a record and more about understanding why large institutions treat gold as a long-term safeguard, and then deciding whether and how much of that logic fits your own plans.

fr.title: Le record de l'or : pourquoi les banques centrales continuent d'acheter et ce que cela signifie

segments.src: Gold has spent much of the past couple of years trading near record highs.
segments.tr: L'or a passé une grande partie de ces deux dernières années à se négocier près de ses sommets historiques.

segments.src: Behind the rally is a steady, large-scale shift in who is buying: central banks.
segments.tr: Derrière cette hausse se cache un changement constant et à grande échelle dans l'identité des acheteurs : les banques centrales.

segments.src: Their purchases have become one of the most closely watched forces in the market.
segments.tr: Leurs achats sont devenus l'une des forces les plus surveillées sur le marché.

segments.src: This article explains what is driving that demand, what it may say about the global financial system, and what it means for everyday savers.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce qui motive cette demande, ce qu'elle peut révéler sur le système financier mondial et ce qu'elle signifie pour les épargnants ordinaires.

segments.src: ## Who is buying, and why it matters
segments.tr: ## Qui achète et pourquoi est-ce important

segments.src: Central banks hold gold as part of their foreign reserves, alongside government bonds and foreign currencies.
segments.tr: Les banques centrales détiennent de l'or dans le cadre de leurs réserves de change, aux côtés des obligations d'État et des devises étrangères.

segments.src: For decades, many of them were net sellers or stayed on the sidelines.
segments.tr: Pendant des décennies, beaucoup d'entre elles ont été des vendeuses nettes ou sont restées en marge.

segments.src: That changed after the 2008 financial crisis, and the pace of buying has picked up further in recent years.
segments.tr: Cela a changé après la crise financière de 2008, et le rythme des achats s'est encore accéléré ces dernières années.

segments.src: According to the World Gold Council, which compiles data from official sources and the International Monetary Fund, annual central bank purchases have recently run well above the long-term average.
segments.tr: Selon le World Gold Council, qui compile les données provenant de sources officielles et du Fonds monétaire international, les achats annuels des banques centrales ont récemment largement dépassé la moyenne à long terme.

segments.src: This matters because central banks are unusual buyers.
segments.tr: Ceci est important car les banques centrales sont des acheteurs inhabituels.

segments.src: They tend to be price-insensitive and long-term.
segments.tr: Elles ont tendance à être insensibles aux prix et à adopter une vision à long terme.

segments.src: They are not trading for quick profit.
segments.tr: Elles ne négocient pas pour réaliser un profit rapide.

segments.src: When they buy, they usually keep the metal for years, which removes supply from the market and can provide a floor under prices.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'elles achètent, elles conservent généralement le métal pendant des années, ce qui retire l'offre du marché et peut constituer un plancher pour les prix.

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## Quatre forces derrière la demande

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
segments.tr: ### 1. Inquiétudes liées à l'inflation

segments.src: Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: Les prix ont fortement augmenté dans de nombreuses économies après 2021.

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: Bien que l'inflation se soit calmée dans plusieurs pays, l'expérience a laissé des traces.

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: L'or est souvent considéré comme une réserve de valeur qui n'est liée aux promesses d'aucun gouvernement.

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques comme les investisseurs ont été rappelés au fait que le pouvoir d'achat de la monnaie peut s'éroder.

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. Préoccupations concernant le dollar et la concentration des réserves

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Le dollar américain

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: reste la monnaie de réserve dominante, et la plupart des analystes s'attendent à ce qu'il le reste pendant longtemps.

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: Même ainsi, de nombreuses banques centrales souhaitent se diversifier.

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: Les niveaux élevés de dette publique dans les grandes économies et le recours aux sanctions financières ont incité certains pays à s'interroger sur la sécurité de détenir une trop grande partie de leurs réserves dans des actifs qui peuvent être gelés ou restreints.

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: L'or n'a pas d'émetteur ni de contrepartie, il ne peut donc pas être gelé de la même manière qu'un dépôt bancaire étranger.

segments.src: This is not the same as abandoning the dollar.
segments.tr: Cela ne revient pas à abandonner le dollar.

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
segments.tr: Il est plus juste de décrire cela comme une diversification progressive à la marge.

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. Risque géopolitique

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: Les guerres, les différends commerciaux et les changements d'alliances ont accru l'incertitude.

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes auprès des gestionnaires de réserves des banques centrales ont souligné à plusieurs reprises le risque géopolitique comme une raison de détenir de l'or.

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: En période d'incertitude, un actif qui conserve sa valeur à travers les crises et qui ne dépend pas du système financier d'un autre pays semble attrayant.

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. Attentes de moindre coût d'opportunité

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: L'or ne rapporte aucun intérêt, il a donc tendance à paraître plus intéressant lorsque les taux d'intérêt devraient baisser ou lorsque les rendements réels (après inflation) des obligations sont faibles.

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: Les changements dans les attentes en matière de taux ont souvent coïncidé avec les mouvements du prix de l'or.

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## Ce que les achats peuvent signaler

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: Les analystes mettent en garde contre le fait de trop interpréter un seul point de données, mais quelques thèmes ressortent :

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **Confiance et diversification.** Les gestionnaires de réserves semblent répartir les risques plus largement que par le passé.

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **Leadership des marchés émergents.** Bon nombre des plus gros acheteurs de ces dernières années ont été des banques centrales d'économies émergentes, qui détiennent souvent relativement peu d'or par rapport à leurs réserves totales.

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.
segments.tr: - **Une couverture, pas une prévision.** Acheter de l'or ne signifie pas nécessairement que les responsables s'attendent à une crise. On achète une assurance parce que l'avenir est incertain, non pas parce qu'une catastrophe est certaine.

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les épargnants ordinaires

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: Les gros titres sur les prix records peuvent inciter les gens à se précipiter.

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: Quelques points de bon sens à garder à l'esprit :

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **Les sommets historiques ne sont pas des garanties.** Les prix de l'or peuvent baisser et baissent effectivement, parfois pendant des années. Après le pic de 2011, les prix ont décliné pendant une longue période avant de se reprendre.

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **L'or ne produit aucun revenu.** Contrairement aux actions qui peuvent verser des dividendes ou aux obligations qui paient des intérêts, le rendement de l'or dépend entièrement de l'évolution de son prix.

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **Les coûts s'accumulent.** L'or physique implique des primes de courtier, de stockage et d'assurance. Les fonds adossés à l'or facturent des frais annuels. Vérifiez ces éléments avant d'acheter.

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.
segments.tr: - **Diversification, pas concentration.** De nombreux éducateurs financiers suggèrent que l'or, s'il est détenu, devrait constituer une part modeste d'un portefeuille diversifié plutôt que la pièce maîtresse.

segments.src: - **Know what you own.** Coins, bars, exchange-traded funds and mining stocks behave differently. Mining shares carry company risk and can swing far more than the metal itself.
segments.tr: - **Sachez ce que vous possédez.** Les pièces, les lingots, les fonds négociés en bourse et les actions minières se comportent différemment. Les actions minières comportent un risque lié à l'entreprise et peuvent fluctuer beaucoup plus que le métal lui-même.

segments.src: - **Beware of pressure sales.** Be skeptical of anyone claiming that gold is a sure thing or urging you to act immediately. Use well-established, regulated sellers.
segments.tr: - **Méfiez-vous des ventes sous pression.** Soyez sceptique envers quiconque prétend que l'or est une valeur sûre ou vous presse d'agir immédiatement. Utilisez des vendeurs bien établis et réglementés.

segments.src: Your own situation matters most: your time horizon, emergency savings, debts and tolerance for ups and downs.
segments.tr: Votre propre situation est ce qui compte le plus : votre horizon temporel, votre épargne de précaution, vos dettes et votre tolérance aux hauts et aux bas.

segments.src: A licensed financial adviser can help weigh these.
segments.tr: Un conseiller financier agréé peut vous aider à évaluer ces éléments.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Central banks are buying gold for reasons that go beyond short-term price moves: inflation memory, a wish to diversify away from heavy reliance on a single currency, and a more uncertain world.
segments.tr: Les banques centrales achètent de l'or pour des raisons qui vont au-delà des mouvements de prix à court terme : mémoire de l'inflation, souhait de se diversifier pour réduire une forte dépendance à une seule monnaie, et un monde plus incertain.

segments.src: Their steady demand has helped keep prices elevated.
segments.tr: Leur demande constante a contribué à maintenir les prix à un niveau élevé.

segments.src: But the same factors that support gold can change quickly, and prices remain volatile.
segments.tr: Mais les mêmes facteurs qui soutiennent l'or peuvent changer rapidement, et les prix restent volatils.

segments.src: For savers, the lesson is less about chasing a record and more about understanding why large institutions treat gold as a long-term safeguard, and then deciding whether and how much of that logic fits your own plans.
segments.tr: Pour les épargnants, la leçon consiste moins à courir après un record qu'à comprendre pourquoi les grandes institutions traitent l'or comme une protection à long terme, puis à décider si et dans quelle mesure cette logique correspond à vos propres plans.

segments.tr: Quando compram, geralmente mantêm o metal por anos, o que retira oferta do mercado e pode fornecer um piso para os preços.

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## Quatro forças por trás da demanda

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
segments.tr: ### 1. Preocupações com a inflação

segments.src: Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: Os preços subiram acentuadamente em muitas economias após 2021.

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: Embora a inflação tenha diminuído em vários países, a experiência deixou uma marca.

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: O ouro é frequentemente visto como uma reserva de valor que não está atrelada às promessas de nenhum governo em particular.

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: Tanto formuladores de políticas quanto investidores foram lembrados de que o poder de compra do dinheiro pode se erosionar.

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. Preocupações com o dólar e concentração de reservas

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: O dólar dos U.S.

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: permanece como a moeda de reserva dominante, e a maioria dos analistas espera que continue assim por muito tempo.

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, muitos bancos centrais querem se diversificar.

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: Níveis elevados de dívida pública nas principais economias e o uso de sanções financeiras levaram alguns países a questionar quão seguro é manter uma parcela muito grande de suas reservas em ativos que podem ser congelados ou restritos.

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: O ouro não tem emissor nem contraparte, portanto não pode ser congelado da mesma forma que um depósito bancário estrangeiro.

segments.src: This is not the same as abandoning the dollar.
segments.tr: Isso não é o mesmo que abandonar o dólar.

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
segments.tr: É melhor descrito como uma diversificação gradual nas margens.

segments.src: ### 3. Geopolitical risk
segments.tr: ### 3. Risco geopolítico

segments.src: Wars, trade disputes and shifting alliances have raised uncertainty.
segments.tr: Guerras, disputas comerciais e alianças em mudança aumentaram a incerteza.

segments.src: Surveys of central bank reserve managers have repeatedly pointed to geopolitical risk as a reason for holding gold.
segments.tr: Pesquisas com gestores de reservas de bancos centrais apontaram repetidamente para o risco geopolítico como um motivo para manter ouro.

segments.src: In uncertain times, an asset that holds value across crises and does not depend on another country's financial system looks attractive.
segments.tr: Em tempos incertos, um ativo que mantém valor através de crises e não depende do sistema financeiro de outro país parece atraente.

segments.src: ### 4. Lower opportunity cost expectations
segments.tr: ### 4. Expectativas de menor custo de oportunidade

segments.src: Gold pays no interest, so it tends to look better when interest rates are expected to fall or when real (after-inflation) returns on bonds are low.
segments.tr: O ouro não paga juros, por isso tende a parecer mais atraente quando se espera que as taxas de juros caiam ou quando os retornos reais (após a inflação) dos títulos estão baixos.

segments.src: Shifts in rate expectations have often coincided with moves in the gold price.
segments.tr: Mudanças nas expectativas de taxas muitas vezes coincidiram com movimentos no preço do ouro.

segments.src: ## What the buying may signal
segments.tr: ## O que as compras podem sinalizar

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading too much into any single data point, but a few themes stand out:
segments.tr: Analistas alertam contra tirar conclusões precipitadas de qualquer ponto de dados isolado, mas alguns temas se destacam:

segments.src: - **Trust and diversification.** Reserve managers appear to be spreading risk more widely than in the past.
segments.tr: - **Confiança e diversificação.** Os gestores de reservas parecem estar distribuindo o risco de forma mais ampla do que no passado.

segments.src: - **Emerging-market leadership.** Many of the largest buyers in recent years have been central banks in emerging economies, which often hold relatively little gold compared with their total reserves.
segments.tr: - **Liderança dos mercados emergentes.** Muitos dos maiores compradores nos últimos anos têm sido bancos centrais em economias emergentes, que frequentemente possuem relativamente pouco ouro em comparação com suas reservas totais.

segments.src: - **A hedge, not a forecast.** Buying gold does not necessarily mean officials expect a crisis. Insurance is bought because the future is uncertain, not because a disaster is certain.
segments.tr: - **Uma proteção, não uma previsão.** Comprar ouro não significa necessariamente que as autoridades esperam uma crise. O seguro é comprado porque o futuro é incerto, não porque um desastre é certo.

segments.src: ## What it means for ordinary savers
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para os poupadores comuns

segments.src: Headlines about record prices can tempt people to rush in.
segments.tr: Manchetes sobre preços recordes podem tentar as pessoas a correrem para comprar.

segments.src: Some grounded points to keep in mind:
segments.tr: Alguns pontos fundamentados a serem lembrados:

segments.src: - **Record highs are not guarantees.** Gold prices can and do fall, sometimes for years. After the peak in 2011, prices declined for a long stretch before recovering.
segments.tr: - **Máximas históricas não são garantias.** Os preços do ouro podem cair e caem, às vezes por anos. Após o pico em 2011, os preços caíram por um longo período antes de se recuperarem.

segments.src: - **Gold produces no income.** Unlike stocks that may pay dividends or bonds that pay interest, gold's return depends entirely on its price change.
segments.tr: - **O ouro não produz renda.** Ao contrário de ações que podem pagar dividendos ou títulos que pagam juros, o retorno do ouro depende inteiramente da variação de seu preço.

segments.src: - **Costs add up.** Physical gold involves dealer premiums, storage and insurance. Gold-backed funds charge annual fees. Check these before buying.
segments.tr: - **Os custos acumulam-se.** O ouro físico envolve prêmios de revendedores, armazenamento e seguro. Fundos apoiados em ouro cobram taxas anuais. Verifique isso antes de comprar.

segments.src: - **Diversification, not concentration.** Many financial educators suggest that gold, if held at all, should be a modest part of a diversified portfolio rather than the centerpiece.
segments.tr: - **Diversificação, não concentração.** Muitos educadores financeiros sugerem que o ouro, se mantido, deve ser uma parte modesta de um portfólio diversificado em vez da peça central.

segments.src: - **Know what you own.** Coins, bars, exchange-traded funds and mining stocks behave differently. Mining shares carry company risk and can swing far more than the metal itself.
segments.tr: - **Saiba o que você possui.** Moedas, barras, fundos negociados em bolsa e ações de mineração comportam-se de maneira diferente. As ações de mineração carregam o risco da empresa e podem oscilar muito mais do que o próprio metal.

segments.src: - **Beware of pressure sales.** Be skeptical of anyone claiming that gold is a sure thing or urging you to act immediately. Use well-established, regulated sellers.
segments.tr: - **Cuidado com vendas sob pressão.** Seja cético em relação a qualquer pessoa que afirme que o ouro é uma certeza ou que o instigue a agir imediatamente. Use vendedores bem estabelecidos e regulamentados.

segments.src: Your own situation matters most: your time horizon, emergency savings, debts and tolerance for ups and downs.
segments.tr: Sua própria situação é o que mais importa: seu horizonte de tempo, reservas de emergência, dívidas e tolerância a altos e baixos.

segments.src: A licensed financial adviser can help weigh these.
segments.tr: Um consultor financeiro licenciado pode ajudar a ponderar esses fatores.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: Central banks are buying gold for reasons that go beyond short-term price moves: inflation memory, a wish to diversify away from heavy reliance on a single currency, and a more uncertain world.
segments.tr: Os bancos centrais estão comprando ouro por razões que vão além dos movimentos de preços de curto prazo: memória inflacionária, o desejo de se diversificar afastando-se da forte dependência de uma única moeda e um mundo mais incerto.

segments.src: Their steady demand has helped keep prices elevated.
segments.tr: Sua demanda constante ajudou a manter os preços elevados.

segments.src: But the same factors that support gold can change quickly, and prices remain volatile.
segments.tr: Mas os mesmos fatores que apoiam o ouro podem mudar rapidamente, e os preços continuam voláteis.

segments.src: For savers, the lesson is less about chasing a record and more about understanding why large institutions treat gold as a long-term safeguard, and then deciding whether and how much of that logic fits your own plans.
segments.tr: Para os poupadores, a lição é menos sobre correr atrás de um recorde e mais sobre entender por que grandes instituições tratam o ouro como uma salvaguarda de longo prazo, e então decidir se e quanto dessa lógica se encaixa nos seus próprios planos.

in.title: Rekor Emas: Mengapa Bank Sentral Terus Membeli dan Apa Tandanya

segments.src: Gold has spent much of the past couple of years trading near record highs.
segments.tr: Emas telah menghabiskan sebagian besar beberapa tahun terakhir dengan diperdagangkan di dekat rekor tertinggi.

segments.src: Behind the rally is a steady, large-scale shift in who is buying: central banks.
segments.tr: Di balik reli tersebut terdapat pergeseran skala besar yang stabil dalam siapa yang membeli: bank sentral.

segments.src: Their purchases have become one of the most closely watched forces in the market.
segments.tr: Pembelian mereka telah menjadi salah satu kekuatan yang paling dicermati di pasar.

segments.src: This article explains what is driving that demand, what it may say about the global financial system, and what it means for everyday savers.
segments.tr: Artikel ini menjelaskan apa yang mendorong permintaan tersebut, apa artinya bagi sistem keuangan global, dan apa artinya bagi penabung sehari-hari.

segments.src: ## Who is buying, and why it matters
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang membeli, dan mengapa itu penting

segments.src: Central banks hold gold as part of their foreign reserves, alongside government bonds and foreign currencies.
segments.tr: Bank sentral menyimpan emas sebagai bagian dari cadangan devisa mereka, bersama dengan obligasi pemerintah dan mata uang asing.

segments.src: For decades, many of them were net sellers or stayed on the sidelines.
segments.tr: Selama beberapa dekade, banyak dari mereka adalah penjual bersih atau tetap berada di pinggir lapangan.

segments.src: That changed after the 2008 financial crisis, and the pace of buying has picked up further in recent years.
segments.tr: Hal itu berubah setelah krisis keuangan 2008, dan laju pembelian semakin meningkat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: According to the World Gold Council, which compiles data from official sources and the International Monetary Fund, annual central bank purchases have recently run well above the long-term average.
segments.tr: Menurut World Gold Council, yang menyusun data dari sumber resmi dan Dana Moneter Internasional, pembelian bank sentral tahunan baru-baru ini berjalan jauh di atas rata-rata jangka panjang.

segments.src: This matters because central banks are unusual buyers.
segments.tr: Hal ini penting karena bank sentral adalah pembeli yang tidak biasa.

segments.src: They tend to be price-insensitive and long-term.
segments.tr: Mereka cenderung tidak sensitif terhadap harga dan berjangka panjang.

segments.src: They are not trading for quick profit.
segments.tr: Mereka tidak berdagang untuk keuntungan cepat.

segments.src: When they buy, they usually keep the metal for years, which removes supply from the market and can provide a floor under prices.
segments.tr: Ketika mereka membeli, mereka biasanya menyimpan logam tersebut selama bertahun-tahun, yang menghilangkan pasokan dari pasar dan dapat memberikan batas bawah pada harga.

segments.src: ## Four forces behind the demand
segments.tr: ## Empat kekuatan di balik permintaan

segments.src: ### 1. Inflation worries
segments.tr: ### 1. Kekhawatiran inflasi

segments.src: Prices rose sharply in many economies after 2021.
segments.tr: Harga naik tajam di banyak ekonomi setelah 2021.

segments.src: Although inflation has cooled in several countries, the experience left a mark.
segments.tr: Meskipun inflasi telah mendingin di beberapa negara, pengalaman tersebut meninggalkan bekas.

segments.src: Gold is often seen as a store of value that is not tied to any one government's promises.
segments.tr: Emas sering dipandang sebagai penyimpan nilai yang tidak terikat pada janji pemerintah mana pun.

segments.src: Policymakers and investors alike have been reminded that the purchasing power of money can erode.
segments.tr: Para pembuat kebijakan dan investor sama-sama diingatkan bahwa daya beli uang dapat terkikis.

segments.src: ### 2. Concerns about the dollar and reserve concentration
segments.tr: ### 2. Kekhawatiran tentang dolar dan konsentrasi cadangan

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Dolar AS

segments.src: dollar remains the dominant reserve currency, and most analysts expect it to stay that way for a long time.
segments.tr: tetap menjadi mata uang cadangan yang dominan, dan sebagian besar analis memperkirakan akan tetap seperti itu untuk waktu yang lama.

segments.src: Even so, many central banks want to diversify.
segments.tr: Meski begitu, banyak bank sentral ingin melakukan diversifikasi.

segments.src: Large government debt levels in major economies and the use of financial sanctions have prompted some countries to ask how safe it is to hold too much of their reserves in assets that can be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: Tingkat utang pemerintah yang besar di ekonomi utama dan penggunaan sanksi keuangan telah mendorong beberapa negara untuk bertanya seberapa aman menyimpan terlalu banyak cadangan mereka dalam aset yang dapat dibekukan atau dibatasi.

segments.src: Gold has no issuer and no counterparty, so it cannot be frozen in the same way as a foreign bank deposit.
segments.tr: Emas tidak memiliki penerbit dan tidak memiliki pihak lawan, sehingga tidak dapat dibekukan dengan cara yang sama seperti deposito bank asing.

segments.src: It is better described as gradual diversification at the margins.
